prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1182; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already spoken with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. We will forward documentation of treatment, lost income, and related expenses once it has been compiled.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, please provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data and telematics, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.
